title: Tanzanian Spiced Goat Roast
author: Chef Jabir
desc: Mbuzi wa Kukaanga na Viungo — whole sections of young goat marinated overnight in a paste of Zanzibar spices, garlic, and ginger, then slow-roasted over charcoal for 2 hours until magnificently charred outside and falling-tender within. The celebration roast of Tanzania.
longDesc: The spiced goat roast is Tanzania's celebration centrepiece — when the occasion demands the highest expression of hospitality, a whole or half goat is marinated overnight in Zanzibar spices and slow-roasted over charcoal. The combination of the spice paste and the low, slow charcoal heat produces a roast of extraordinary complexity.
ingredients: ½ cup fresh coriander — blended in
steps: Score goat sections deeply all over.
Blend all marinade ingredients into a smooth paste.
Rub paste deep into every score and all over the surface.
Prepare large charcoal fire. Allow to reach glowing coals.
Roast over medium-low indirect heat for 90—120 minutes, turning every 20—30 minutes.
Move to direct heat in the final 15 minutes for a magnificent char.
chefTips: Overnight marination allows the spice paste to penetrate deep through the scores.
Low and slow — the goat must be completely tender before the final char.
The final direct heat is what creates the magnificent caramelised crust.
commonMistakes: Too high heat throughout — burns outside before inside cooks.
cookingScience: The overnight marinade with its acidic lemon juice partially denatures surface proteins, allowing the spice compounds to penetrate deeper. The extended low-heat roasting converts connective tissue collagen to gelatin, producing falling-tender meat beneath the caramelised spice crust.
sustainabilityTips: Young Tanzanian goat — supporting local pastoral communities.
healthBenefits: Goat is leaner than beef or lamb.
culturalNote: The spiced goat roast is Tanzania's highest expression of celebratory cooking — the dish that marks the most important occasions and demonstrates the greatest hospitality. The overnight preparation and hours of patient roasting signal how much the occasion matters.
